WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
An Intern + FTE account describes an assessment with three coding tasks and two SQL queries, then two virtual coding interviews with OOP, SQL and database fundamentals.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTYxNg

A software-engineer account describes a one-hour, three-problem HackerRank test on arrays, strings and DP. Interview examples include next-greater-element, linked-list cycle detection, Java streams/lambdas, garbage collection, and detailed discussion of project challenges.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTYxOA

An SDE report describes three coding tasks in 70 minutes. Interview tasks include building a BST from sorted data, a linked-list deletion variant, palindrome checking, and converting numbers to words, alongside Java threading, OS synchronization and project scalability.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTYxNw

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
17 published non-mock question records. Types: MCQ: 8, CODING: 6, SQL: 3.
Difficulty labels: Medium: 12, Easy: 4, Hard: 1.
16/17 records have usable topic labels.
Most frequent stored topics: Data Structures (7), Array (6), Stack (4), Greedy (3), Dynamic Programming (3), Hash Table (2), String (2), SQL (2).
A question can have several tags. These frequencies describe the uploaded corpus; they do not predict the next OA. Mock and duplicate-marked questions are excluded.
